description: This script is a test file for validating git svn integration with internationalization and commit encoding configurations. It includes functions for comparing git commits and svn logs, sets locale environments, and performs cloning, committing, and dcommit operations with different encoding settings, primarily focusing on how commit encodings are respected and handled.

methods.name: compare_git_head_with
methods.description: Compares the current git HEAD commit message with a specified file, ensuring they match.

methods.name: prepare_utf8_locale
methods.description: Sets up the UTF-8 locale environment for tests.

methods.name: compare_svn_head_with
methods.description: Compares the SVN log message with a specified file, extracting the relevant log entries for comparison.
